title: Gum Gum Whip
content: it’s like 3am and I woke up to the most vivid dream I’ve had in a very long time. idk if it’s just because I’m on my cycle but this shit was crazy. long story short it was an apocalyptic type dream and everyone was a zombie. It was so nasty and the feeling was unmatched by far. My senses were so heightened, and It felt a little “too real.” I literally had to bust into rooms because people wouldn’t let me and this woman entity (that idk but she’s with me all the time) in. As soon as we get into a room, some guy is trying to break the door down and that’s when I had to get lucid cause I genuinely felt like I was under attack, fight or flight kicked in. I jetted for a window that I knew I could just open and jump through….and that’s when it happened. An “npc” from in the room(some guy) immediately helped me. THAT SHIT NEVER HAPPENS. Like we didn’t even have to speak, it’s like he knew the plan. He took my spot holding the door shut for everyone, while I run across the room to open the window. There were like 5-6 of us in that one room. I think I realized it was inevitable that we all weren’t gonna make it out the room, so I deadass just turned around and (if you watch One Piece) GUM GUM PISTOL WHIPPED THAT ASS, I punched ts outta him. Idk it felt so real I woke up and had to write this after journaling
